description: patterns plugin hooks: (1) UserPromptSubmit — on a design-shaped prompt, inject the tier-1 trigger->pattern menu rendered at runtime from catalog/patterns.json; (2) PreToolUse on Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit — once per user message, on the first source-code write, remind to check pattern selection (additionalContext only; no permissionDecision, no block). Both default ON (env PATTERNS_ENABLED / project or global .claude/patterns.json {"enabled": false} to opt out), fail-open on any error.
